description:
IntelCue monitors competitor and market signals, then turns them into live context for ChatGPT.

Access monitored market data, competitor updates, trends, and insights directly from your IntelCue workspace.

Use IntelCue in ChatGPT to:
• Get a weekly briefing on what happened in your market
• Find what competitors are launching or promoting
• Analyze how competitor messaging has evolved
• Create competitive briefs and market summaries
• Draft a LinkedIn post from the week’s top trending topic
• Check for competitor moves from the last three days

IntelCue helps teams track competitors and market movements, understand emerging trends and signals, generate briefs, reports, and content ideas, and make decisions using continuously updated intelligence within ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Give me a weekly briefing on the most important trends, competitor moves, and keywords in my market.
What significant competitor moves were detected in the last three days, and why do they matter?
Find this week’s strongest trending topic and draft a LinkedIn post based on the supporting intelligence.
